judgments.reason: The span 'progressive unilateral skin hardening on his right thigh and buttock' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports localized morphea/scleroderma as a diagnosis.

The span 'ill-defined, stony-hard plaque involving his right thigh above the patella extending to his right buttocks' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports localized morphea with its characteristic indurated plaque presentation.

The span 'subtle increase in density of fibroblasts extending to the subcutis and forming adipocyte entrapment' appears literally in the vignette and is a recognized histopathological feature of morphea/localized scleroderma.

The span 'Increased expression of CD34 in the reticular dermis' appears literally in the vignette and is a known immunohistochemical finding in morphea, supporting the diagnosis of localized scleroderma.
